free_tier.stated: No free tier stated. Token Plan is a Credits-billed subscription for interactive use in compatible AI tools; the overview page gives no price and no free allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: a Token Plan API key (sk-sp-) plus the Bailian CLI; Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent are named
chaining: monthly Credits spent through the China-region base URL; Standard and Pro plans add Harness MCP benefits

limits.value: monthly Credits allowance; amount and price not stated on the overview page

identity_cost.detail: an Aliyun account and a purchased Token Plan; real-name verification for Chinese cloud accounts is common but not stated on this page

reliability_note: no free allowance to throttle; the plan requires purchase

evidence.quote: Token Plan 是阿里云百炼的 AI 模型订阅服务，以 Credits 统一计量，支持在兼容的 AI 工具中交互式使用。
evidence.proved: Token Plan is a paid Credits-based subscription with no free allowance stated
